submit_reasoning: The price history shows 137 daily bars with a mean of ~156.00, std of ~2.48, and a recent recovery from a mid-series dip to ~150 up to ~159.57 at the last bar. No anomalies were detected, and seasonality was negligible (strength 0.0). The article is bearish (Zacks Rank #5 Strong Sell, EPS estimate revisions lower, expected EPS decline of 42.44%, industry in bottom 10%), but all four context events I extracted were rejected by Aion's ablation gate — meaning they did not earn their place beyond what the price history already captures. Both history-only and event-informed runs selected the same linear_trend model and produced identical 33-step trajectories, projecting a gentle upward trend from ~159.71 to ~160.73. I submit the history-only run (fc1) as the cleanest version of this forecast.
